Health information and sources

Lookin provides general information about food and movement. Consult a qualified professional before making medical decisions. AI answers can be wrong. Sources do not validate personal calorie or protein targets, recipe nutrition or photo estimates. Check estimates before saving. Custom foods are your own unverified entries; use current packaging information. Sources last checked: 29 October 2026.

  • WHO – Healthy diet

    General principles of a varied diet and choosing whole grains, vegetables, fruit and pulses.

  • NHS – Understanding calories

    Calories as a unit of energy, differing energy needs and nutrition information on packaging.

  • WHO – Physical activity

    Everyday physical activity, such as walking and cycling, and reducing sedentary time.

  • EFSA – Dietary reference values

    Interpreting nutrient reference values: population references are not personal nutrient targets.

Source links open external websites, which process connection data under their own privacy notices. Lookin does not attach chat, profile or diary data to the links.
